svg.text: Lanes D and E — the two lanes that could not start on day one
Both wait on lane A output; lane D additionally waits on the golden vectors lane B generates.
Lane D · Scenario_Player/ — group 0.5
bench CpmContent dataclass
+ golden round-trip test
The only lane verifiable on the dev host — pure Python.
Hard constraint: no UPER encode or decode from Python. The
bench codec path stayed open, decided later in the bench HLD.
Golden fixtures are copied .json side only.
Lane E · IVI_ECU/ — group 0.6
sealed warning Kotlin binding
finalizes the interim snapshot models
IVI additive-version test
Both supersede an already-numbered Phase 5 subtask;
ownership was reconciled and no ID was renumbered.
Lane E is the one lane whose test command could not run at all on the dev host: the local JDK exceeds the Gradle wrapper's supported range, so CI is the authority.
Lane D's single subtask ran first of the three still open once the golden vectors landed, precisely because it was the only locally verifiable one.
Neither lane could have been pulled earlier: their inputs are frozen contract artifacts, not effort.
